---
title: "Easy Oatmeal Raisin Breakfast Bars"
description: |
  Oatmeal raisin or chocolate chip breakfast bars.
date: 03-20-2021
categories:
  - baked
  - oatmeal
  - breakfast
  - bar
---

Bake at 350F.

## Ingredients

* two ripe bananas, mashed (about 1 cup)
* 2 1/4 cups oats
* 1/2 cup all-purpose flour
* 1/2 tsp baking powder
* 1 tsp cinnamon
* 1/2 cup honey
* 1 cup raisins or chocolate chips

## Directions

* Preheat oven to 350 F.
* Grease a 8x11 or 9x9 baking pan.

* Mash **two** bananas (about 1 cup) with a fork in the bottom of your mixing bowl.
* Directly on top of the mashed banana, dump in **2 1/4 cups** oats, **1/2 cup** flour, **1/2 tsp** baking powder and **1 tsp** cinnamon.
* Gently mix the dry ingredients together without mixing them into the banana.
* Add **1/2 cup** honey to oat mixture and stir until combined, stir in the **1 cup** chocolate chips or raisins.
* Scoop into the pan, and compress, smoothing out the top.
* Bake 25-30 minutes, or until top of the bars are firm and golden brown.
* Let cool, cut into squares. Store in the fridge or freezer.

Original sourced from [Nibble and Dine Easy Oatmeal Raisin Breakfast Bars](https://nibbleanddine.com/easy-oatmeal-raisin-breakfast-bars/?fbclid=IwAR3SFGy_rPVgo1Nc6ybOZBULJYDPGY0W_yO7ST1HOV6uYDDHG3p1AZJO8U0#tasty-recipes-3178)

## Nutritional Information

3000 kCal for ingredients, and then 10 servings / pan is 300 kCal / serving.
